Description

DEVICE_STATUS bytes 0-3. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_STATUS. The USB Recovery Agent read-clear action for PROTOCOL_ERROR is generated by the control-transfer decoder only after a completed USB read; internal firmware reads are non-destructive.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:16] REC_REASON_CODE r 0x0 Recovery reason code
[15:8] PROT_ERROR r 0x0 Protocol error
[7:0] DEV_STATUS r 0x0 Device status

Field Descriptions

REC_REASON_CODE - Recovery reason code

Bytes 2-3 report the 16-bit recovery reason code. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_STATUS and Table 3.

PROT_ERROR - Protocol error

Byte 1 reports protocol error. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 defines clear-on-read for the Recovery Agent USB command; the control-transfer decoder performs that clear after a completed USB DEVICE_STATUS read. Internal firmware reads do not clear the field.

DEV_STATUS - Device status

Byte 0 reports device health and recovery state. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_STATUS.
